A tight ring of 66 clones hence holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 57% independent neighbours on the funding graph. That is 27 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
